# Copilot Summary: Requirements Routing — test-app

Use this summary before loading multiple requirement files. Its job is to route you to the right requirement document quickly.

## Source of Truth

- `docs/product/requirements/README.md`

## First Stop

- Start with `docs/product/requirements/README.md` when a task changes behavior, constraints, or verification expectations.

## Requirement File Routing

Requirements files live in `docs/product/requirements/`. Use the index in `README.md` to identify which file owns the area you are changing.

Common routing patterns:
- Performance, security, usability, reliability, privacy, compatibility, accessibility → non-functional requirements file
- User-facing feature behavior → the feature-specific requirements file
- Setup, install, env variables → installation / technical requirements file
- Test behavior, coverage expectations → testing requirements file (if present)

## Status Rules

Only use these values in requirement tables:

- `✓ Met`
- `✗ Not met`
- `⬜ N/T`

Do not add new rows or new requirement files unless the user explicitly changes the requirements system.

## Escalate Beyond This Summary When

- the task affects multiple feature areas simultaneously
- you need exact requirement IDs or acceptance criteria
- the task is primarily about NFRs or installation constraints
- a new requirements file is being proposed (requires approval)
